destination.name: Tamworth
destination.tagline: A regional city known as Australia's country music capital.
destination.description: Tamworth is a city of 43,874 people (2021 census) on the Peel River, almost midway between Brisbane and Sydney. It is called Australia's Country Music Capital, and was the first place in Australia to use electric street lights, in 1888. A 12 m golden guitar stands at the southern entrance beside the visitor centre, and the Australian Country Music Hall of Fame is on Peel Street.
whyVisit: Browse the Country Music Hall of Fame

goodToKnow.title: Guitar and visitor centre
goodToKnow.detail: The guitar is floodlit and open 24 hours; the visitor centre beside it is open 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM daily.

goodToKnow.title: Hall of Fame hours
goodToKnow.detail: The museum is open 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Tuesday to Sunday, and entry is about $10.

goodToKnow.title: Train link
goodToKnow.detail: NSW TrainLink trains connect Tamworth with Armidale, the Hunter Valley and Sydney (Wikivoyage).

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Come in {months}: the Tamworth Country Music Festival runs in late January and is the second-biggest country music festival in the world after Nashville.
